steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Ah, what a coincidence!

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Are you supposed to be here?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: According to the regulations of the Eastside Public Security Bureau, the beat of the bureau's sheriffs includes every area of land in DisCity. We're tasked to handle emergencies, and...

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Are you saying the MBCC is also part of your beat?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Yes.
The sheriff nods, her expression serious. You've found yourself in similar situations many times this month.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Ah, what a coincidence.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: It's a coincidence indeed.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Ah, what a coincidence.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Ah, what a coincidence!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: You were in the Public Security Bureau when the news was announced. You must already know the intelligence we've received, that the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> are making a move.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: It is believed that the organization has recruited a Sinner. So, as a sheriff, I'm required to keep in contact with the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Don't you think we've had way too many "chance" encounters lately?
In the past month, this sheriff by the name of Jane managed to "accidentally" run into you every time you were on a mission outside the MBCC.
She'd share with you the latest information she learned about the Ghosts, and then join you in whatever you were doing that day.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: How did you know my schedule?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Telepathy.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I want your shackles.
This phrase has become a mantra of hers. You've heard her say it more times than you can count.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Let me say this again, Miss Jane; the shackles are of no use to ordinary people.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: They wouldn't help you become better at helping the elderly cross the road, unlocking doors for those who've lost their keys, or performing gun disassembly in front of kids.
You list the things Jane has done over the past month.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Really? That's a pity. But I won't give up.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Why are you so obsessed with the shackles?

choices.text: Why are you so obsessed with the shackles?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I want to become stronger, much stronger.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Or you could make me an MBCC Sinner. What do you say?
Jane makes a peace sign, her face betraying nothing. The Band-Aids wrapped around her index and ring fingers are stained with dried blood. She must have been training hard in secret.

steps.speaker: Option
options: If you become a Sinner, you can't be a sheriff anymore.

choices.text: If you become a Sinner, you can't be a sheriff anymore.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I see... That's a pity.
Jane shakes her head, then suddenly looks up at you, as if she's just remembered something.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Um, there is this person who is a robber turned sheriff. What do you think of that?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Why would this person want to become a sheriff?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Maybe it's because this person thought they could do better and wanted to live a virtuous life.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: They were sick of cracking safes and robbing banks in Eastside during the day, and sleeping in an armory at night.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: This person wanted to get back at their fellow robbers, so they joined the opposite side.

steps.speaker: Option
options: How is this person adjusting to their new life in the PSB?

choices.text: How is this person adjusting to their new life in the PSB?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: It sounds like something that can only happen in fiction.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Real life can be more fantastical than fiction sometimes.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Hmm, hard to say how well this person is adjusting.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Maybe, for this robber turned sheriff, choosing to join the Public Security Bureau means they have found their moral compass. Maybe.

steps.speaker: Option
options: You're quite an expert on this subject, it seems.

choices.text: You're quite an expert on this subject, it seems.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I... This is the personal experience of one of my colleagues. I overheard it while I was slacking at work. Sounds pretty awesome, huh?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: A more suitable place for this colleague of yours would be the MBCC. Many of the MBCC Sinners have similar experiences.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I see, but unfortunately, this person isn't a Sinner. There is no Sinner in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Not a Sinner... Well, in that case, I'll have to ask Nightingale about this. We'll do a background check first, of course.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Hahaha...
Jane laughs so hard that tears come out of her eyes.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: You are actually considering it?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: The bureau's logistics department could use one or two more staffers. I don't see why not, if it's someone you trust.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: If the chance presents itself, I'll tell this person you're hiring and have them message you.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: So what's your colleague's name?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: That's a secret.
With that, Jane gives a wave and sets off in the direction of the Public Security Bureau.
Two grappling hooks are securely attached to the ledge of the roof of the Bank of Eastside building. The leader of the group tugs at the rope to make sure it's in working order.

steps.speaker: Leopard
steps.content: Boss, do we still wait for her?

steps.speaker: Warg
steps.content: It's better if she doesn't come. More money for us.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: She will come.
With that, he grabs the pulley attached to the rope and quickly descends to the predetermined location. The rest of the group, all heavily armed, follow suit.

With a kick, the glass shatters. Almost at the same moment, the lights go out, accompanied by the impatient rat-a-tat of submachine guns and the screams of the crowd. The <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> have stormed into the bank.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Listen up, everyone! Hands over your head and squat in the corner. No one is coming to save you. So if you want to live, keep your mouth shut.
The security guard tries to fight back, only to be shot by Coleman in the chest and fall onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Don't worry. I'm sure the bullet didn't penetrate your bulletproof vest. Cracked a rib or two, maybe. I've given you a chance to take a few days' leave. Ah, I'm so very kind.
The teller at the counter frantically presses the panic button, but it doesn't respond.

steps.speaker: Leopard
steps.content: The bank's main power switch has been turned off. Once the boss finishes the job, we'll split the money. Same as always.

steps.speaker: Warg
steps.content: What's the percentage for each of us this time?

steps.speaker: Leopard
steps.content: Ten percent.

steps.speaker: Warg
steps.content: Ten percent? I don't understand why the boss wants that bratty girl in on this and take a cut.
If two of them were gone, would the rest get more?

steps.speaker: Leopard
steps.content: Of course. Isn't that obvious?

steps.speaker: Warg
steps.content: Wait...
A familiar mask appears behind the two. Before they know what happens, bang, bang...
The lights in the bank blink on, and the alarm goes off.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Looks like you've learned a lot.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You're finally owning up to your desires, it seems. Fewer people, more money, right?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Yeah. Never hesitate to shoot. That's what you taught me, remember?

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Hahaha... Of course I remember. Now this is the way the future leader of the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> is supposed to be!

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Let's go. We're heading back! There will be bigger banks for us to rob, and larger sums of money to steal in the future.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I'm not going, Coleman.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Sigh... I thought you had sorted yourself out. You've proved me wrong again...
As soon as he finishes speaking, they open fire on each other.
They move deftly in the dim light, dodging behind this iron structure or that to protect themselves from the flying bullets.

Coleman vaults over an obstacle and unleashes several shots in Jane's direction. Jane quickly glides out of the way. The bullets hit the thick vault door, ricochet off it, and one of them grazes Jane's shoulder and draws blood.

Jane is losing. She keeps getting hit, moving backward step by step. Bullets have pierced her left arm and right leg. The excruciating pain makes even the simple act of holding her gun steady difficult for her.
She keeps pulling the trigger, even after she has exhausted the bullets in the magazine and all the spare ones. Her body is trembling uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Tsk tsk! What a letdown.
Striding nonchalantly as if he's bored with what's going on, he comes to stand in front of Jane. He knocks the gun out of her hand and points his at her forehead.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Sigh...
Jane closes her eyes, her body trembling slightly.
Have I failed again? Failed to escape from this demon's clutches.
The expected pain doesn't come. Jane hears a shout coming from afar. The voice sounds familiar...
When you and Hecate storm into the bank, you're greeted by a scene of utter confusion.
The marble pillars are riddled with bullet holes, and the bank documents are scattered everywhere, courtesy of a hand grenade's impact.
You see the frightened civilians trapped in the bank and ask the Sinner who has come with you to protect them.
You walk into the bowels of the building. The strong door to the vault stands half open. A man and a woman are facing off inside. They are wearing masks. You recognize one of them.
Jane is in a dire situation. You quickly call Hecate by radio for help.
Help arrives immediately. A purple laser beam melts the wall and makes its way into the vault.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Ah, you were quick.
Nightmare's laser beam hits the masked man but fails to incapacitate him. He quickly retreats, disappearing behind the vault door.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Stop! Don't go! I'm gonna kill you here and now!

Jane's wounds are nowhere near fatal, but they hinder her mobility greatly. Her hands are trembling so hard that she can't aim properly, yet she grits her teeth, raises her gun, and points it at the fleeing man.
You sense the vibration of the shackles inside of you. It's caused by another powerful source of Mania other than Hecate's.
It's Jane, you realize.
You've always suspected that she is a Sinner, but you couldn't be certain, because you never saw her use her Sinner ability, not even in her battle against the Corruptor.
Who exactly is that person who escaped?

The bank robbers have prepared a perfect escape route beforehand. The remaining members of the group start firing at the sheriffs just outside the main entrance of the bank. You pull Jane along and hide behind the counter.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: You saved me again.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: I will...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Take it from here, again?
She interrupts you, removing her mask.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: No. I'm not letting you. I have to do it myself this time.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Because of him, I became a Sinner. Because of him, I became a notorious robber.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: He planted the seeds of my sins, and they grew in the soil that was the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color>...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I couldn't do anything back then. But now, now I want to end it with my own hands.
You look at the injured girl in front of you, shaking your head.
With an effort, she leans forward and rests her chin on your shoulder. You can't see her face. Her soft voice whispers in your ear.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Give me the shackles.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Please... give me the shackles...
You've never received such a request from a Sinner before. It's a plea.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I want... to take a gamble...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: All my life, I've let others make tough decisions for me...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: There's no need for you to make any promises or feel responsible for whatever might happen...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Lend me the power to fight back... That's all I ask of you.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Will you come and participate in other operations in the future?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: If you don't, I'll come find you.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Or you could make me an MBCC Sinner. That way, I can use the power of your shackles.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Maybe it's because this person thought they could do better and wanted to live a virtuous life.
So obstinate.
That's only to be expected. She is a Sinner, after all.
You hold her hand. The red chain appears and hovers over her body for a second before disappearing again.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: This is a Heal Potestas. Not as powerful as the abilities of Catalyst Sinners, but it'll have to do.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Here, take my gun. It still has bullets in it.
You remove your gun and hand it to Jane.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: ...Thank you.
She takes the gun, cocks it, and steps out of the hiding place.
The masked man reappears, his skin now adorned with visible cracks. Hecate wants to attack him again but you stop her.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Let's have another round, just you and me. No one will interfere.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You'd better kill me this time, or...
Their showdown resumes...
Bullets whistle in the air. She dodges out of the way, gets closer to her target, and unleashes a volley of shots. One of the bullets hits and passes through his left arm.
This is the first time he's sustained any significant amount of damage, but he bursts into laughter, his body trembling.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Hahaha... great, great! You're finally showing your true colors!

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Embrace your true self, Jane. Deep down you know you're not a Public Security Bureau sheriff.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You're in my camp, always have been. You're not a sheriff, you're a bank robber!

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: We're the most notorious bank robbers in Eastside.
Coleman raises his gun to shoot. Jane dodges while responding to the man's remarks.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I know I was a bank robber.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I've lived in fear for too long. I feared the consequences of failure, feared everything I cherished would be destroyed by you.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: It's different now. Now I have the power to fight back. I'm going to end my nightmare today.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Hahaha! You're all bark and no bite.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: I know you well. You don't have the courage to do what you say you're going to do. Staying on the dark side with us and doing evil, that's what you were born to do. And you know how wonderful it makes you feel.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: I still remember the look on your face when you opened a bank vault for the first time and got your hands on your first stolen sum of money.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: It wasn't a look of shame or self-reproach, but a look of excitement, indescribable excitement.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Shut up!
Jane fires continuously at Coleman, but Coleman is still laughing like a madman.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Ah, what you've been suppressing isn't your desire to kill, but your power—Criminal Palpitations.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You're not fit to be a sheriff at all. I didn't stop you from joining the Public Security Bureau, because I wanted to see how big a fool you would make of yourself...
You sense, via the shackles, that Jane's emotions are in turmoil.
Very few Sinners reveal their identities willingly, especially those in Eastside.
Jane revealed hers, only because she wanted you to put the shackles on her to become more powerful.

options: She must have been a victim of oppression for too long...

choices.text: She must have been a victim of oppression for too long...

steps.content: Believe in yourself. That's what you need to do.
I believe in myself.
I don't care about what other people say, or do.
You're now blessed with the power of the shackles. Go and win the battle.
The shackles blink red and bright. The duel between the two heavily wounded fighters is nearing its end.
There is no bullet left in the magazine of either of their guns. They're locked in a stalemate. Who will emerge victorious?

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: The winner... is me! You have no means of harming me now.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You in gray clothes, you said you wouldn't interfere. I'm leaving now. You won't stop me, I reckon?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I must... do this...
Coleman turns to leave, planning to join his accomplices. Jane musters all her strength and lunges at Coleman.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You...

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: Why are you so eager to die? I'll grant your wish then.
Coleman pulls out a dagger and forcefully stabs Jane.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: What a pity. We're so alike. We're both monsters... I didn't want to kill you.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: But... I... want to kill you!
With blood dripping from her mask, Jane presses the muzzle of her handgun against Coleman's unprotected forehead.

steps.speaker: Coleman
steps.content: You ran out of bullets long ago. Stop fooling yourself.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I've got one left. The one I should've put in your head three years ago...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Goodbye, my... nightmare.
Coleman opens his mouth to say something, but the bullet shuts him up. Bang! He falls onto the floor.
The shell casing jumps out of the chamber and lands on the floor.
There's a small line of text written on it.
Dear daughter, forge ahead without fear and overcome any force of evil that stands in your way.
